授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, a basic ability and methdorogy to propose new ideas on transportation machines, especially aviation engines, will be obtained, by the basics of aeronautical engineering and aviation engine design and applications of engineering theories learned so far. Furthermore, students will understand the importance of implementing research outcomes in society and learn methods to advance research using machine learning.
advice:
The department of Aeronautics and Astronautics aims to develop engineers who can support the development of transportation machines such as aircraft using knowledge of aerospace, machine design, and production technology of transportation machines. Design Project III is the subject of the collected studies in the final stage of the curriculum. The targets of this subject are the following:
-to develop the abilities of design and analysis through the designing of actual transport machines such as aircraft, applying theories of mainly aeronautics, and evaluating actual phenomena relating to the transportation machines such as aircraft.
-to develop the ability to estimate the obtained results from the aeronautical engineering viewpoint.
A detailed project theme is decided through discussion with the teacher. Students will discover their own problems and solve them. The example of the themes are described as follows:
 (1) Research and development of combustor technology for high power, high efficiency, and low pollution.
 (2) Experimental study on engine noise reduction structure.
 (3) Development of combustor concept design tools using optimization techniques and machine learning.
 (4) Research and development of other phenomena and systems in aerospace engineering
Students must also understand the targets of this subject, and an overview of the content of the course and the objectives based on the syllabus. In particular, students must understand which part of the learning objectives of this department this subject carries and a detailed level of the achievement.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)	Student clearly understands the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose.
(2)	Students prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present and discuss it. Students prepare their research result as a final report and make a presentation and discuss it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. In addition, students can report this final result in the scientific journal relating to their major subject and can receive outside evaluation.
(3)	Students conduct design and production activities on their own and use CAD and CFD tools actively as needed and can evaluate their performance.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Student clearly understands the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose.

(2) Students should prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it. Students prepare the final result as a final report and present it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting.
